title: living rent-free in my head
caption:
the tenants who never pay and never leave.

an answer from 2014 that still saves me weekly. a regex I copied once
and have never dared to read. and a variable named temp that has been
in production since 2022.

what's living rent-free in your head?

items: still the only thing that works
I fear it. I will not read it
learned it, loved it, lost it
